name: EBAZ4205
sources: https://github.com/KeitetsuWorks/EBAZ4205 (MIT): Vivado PS7 settings, ps7_init_gpl.c, constraints
https://github.com/xjtuecho/EBAZ4205 and https://gist.github.com/mwalle/d8291e241075d82d1d420afa9302bd91: PL pin map (they agree on every pin)

notes: SD card boot needs the microSD slot (U7) mounted and resistor R2577 shorted (boot mode SD instead of NAND).
Power: 12 V on the J4 connector needs diode D24 shorted (or feed 12 V on the data connector).
Serial console: UART1 on MIO 24 (TX) / 25 (RX), 3.3 V, 115200 baud.
The Ethernet works after U-Boot has loaded the Ardzy base design (base.bit on the card).

ethernet.via: EMIO MII, PHY IP101GA at MDIO address 0, 100 Mbit/s

header_notes: DATA1/2/3: 2x10 pin headers, 3.3 V FPGA pins with no protection. Pins 1-4 are power and ground, 10 and 12 ground (check your board).

clock_pin.note: only if the X5 oscillator is mounted
